verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs confirm you can create issues and manage projects (github-docs-12), work with issues on mobile, and work with issues from the CLI. Assignees appear only indirectly, in a community note that multiple assignees are a paid-plan feature for private repos. Missing for 10: any evidence of labels for categorizing bugs, features or requirements; first-party documentation of assignees; hands-on corroboration of an issue-tracking workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bugs, features, and requirements as issues with labels and assignees

citations.quote: Create issues and manage projects with tools that adapt to your code.
Read, review, and collaborate on issues and pull requests
GitHub CLI is a command-line tool that brings pull requests, issues, GitHub Actions, and other GitHub features to your terminal
